title: Ten Winters and One Short Chimney
subtitle: 污染治理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 污染治理（人与自然·环境保护与可持续发展）
meta: 主题语境：污染治理（人与自然·环境保护与可持续发展）　|　核心词汇：factory　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 factory 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 my uncle ① ran a factory that no inspector in the valley would have closed, and he said the running was the whole of the winter. The ② factory, meaning the works itself and not the office, ran ten winters and stayed unclosed in the book; a factory, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unclosed.

Every ③ factory in that valley had the same short chimney beside it, and the ④ factory at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the night shift and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A factory, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to close; my uncle said the closing is the part that fills ten winters.

My aunt meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the factory was the whole of the argument, meaning the trade and not the works. The ⑥ factory, meaning the trade and not any of that, is the only thing in an argument that everybody waits for and nobody closes; factory, she said, is either something you run or the only word that means both a works and a trade. She said the trade is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ factory had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short chimney. The ⑧ factory of the whole thing, my uncle wrote in January, was one valley and ten winters of closing; factory, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to close. He said the closing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ factory I remember is the one closed in the report, which closed in 1970 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ factory, my mother said in 1972, is the only one that improves by being closed; every factory, she said, is a trade that has agreed to look like a works. She said the trade was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 工厂（指山谷里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 工厂（指那座厂房本身，与办公室相对）
C. 固定搭配：run a factory 经营一家工厂
D. n. 工厂（指留给夜班的那一座）
E. n. 工厂（抽象总称，指一条山谷的办厂之事）
F. n. 工厂（指报告上写到、被关停的那一座）
G. n. 制造业；行业（指一场争论里人人都等却无人关停的那样东西）
H. n. 行业（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人关停的那样东西）

items.q: ran a factory that no inspector in the valley would have closed
The factory, meaning the works itself and not the office
the factory at the far side
the factory was the whole of the argument
the factory had become a line in a report
The factory of the whole thing
A factory, my mother said in 1972

answers.why: run a factory 意为“经营一家工厂”，1958 年叔叔经营了一家山谷里没有一位检查员肯关停的工厂。
factory 意为“工厂”，指那座厂房本身而不是办公室，它经过了十个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
factory 意为“工厂”，指山谷里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一根短短的烟囱。
factory 意为“工厂”，指留给夜班的那一座，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
factory 意为“制造业、行业”，指一场争论里人人都等却无人关停的那样东西，姑姑说这个行业就是那场争论的全部。
factory 意为“行业”，指人人都等却无人关停的那样东西而不是那座厂房，是争论里人人都等、却无人关停的东西。
factory 意为“工厂”，指报告上写到、被关停的那一座，到 1967 年这一座成了报告里的一行。
factory 意为“工厂”，叔叔一月写道，整件事的办厂之事是一条山谷和十个冬天的关停。
factory 意为“工厂”，我记得的是报告上关停的那一座，1970 年关了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一座。
factory 为抽象总称，母亲 1972 年说，一家工厂是唯一会因为被好好关停而变得更好的东西。
